entities.name: Aryl bromide heterocycle
observations: The aryl bromide is the selective coupling handle in the supported precedent.

entities.name: Pyridone NH reactant
observations: The lactam/pyridone N–H acts as the nucleophile in CuI-mediated N-arylation.

entities.name: Ullmann N-arylation product
observations: CuI/diamine/base-promoted C–N coupling replaces the aryl bromide with the pyridone nitrogen.
